what: Magna International is one of the world's largest car parts makers. It supplies body structures, seats, mirrors, powertrain components and electronics, and also builds complete vehicles under contract in Austria.
customers: Carmakers worldwide, with the largest exposure to North American and European manufacturers.
money: body panels, frames and exterior systems
contract manufacturing of whole cars in Austria
moat: Content designed into vehicle platforms years ahead and supplied for the model's life, plus the rare ability to assemble complete vehicles for carmakers that lack capacity.
risks: Net margin of about 2% is thin, as is normal for a car parts supplier
European car production has been falling
Tariffs disrupt a business with plants across North America and Europe
opportunities: Analysts see about 17% upside from current levels
A dividend yield above 3% with a long payment record
Content per vehicle rises as cars add electronics and driver assistance
watch: Light vehicle production volumes in North America and Europe, and margin by segment.
